structured.message:
I can help with orders on your own account, but I can't look up, refund, or make changes to an order that belongs to another customer, including a family member's. If order #W8309293 is your cousin's, they will need to contact us directly from their own account.

If you have your own order with a broken keyboard, I can help with that. To verify your identity, please provide either:
- the email address on your account, or
- your first name, last name, and zip code.
